title: Outliers: The Story of Success
author: Malcolm Gladwell
summary: Malcolm Gladwell argues that high achievers owe much to circumstances such as birth date, culture and opportunity. He uses stories from hockey, the Beatles and Bill Gates to build his case, including the 10,000-hour idea.
readIf: you like readable, story-led arguments about why some people succeed.
skipIf: you want tight statistics, since critics find his generalisations loose.
